scenarios.when: A command for the bound host returns an active_connection_*, workbuddy_*, or host_credential_adapter_unavailable local failure, including when the user asks to continue generation.
scenarios.then: Stop the automatic API flow. Do not invoke connection, init, doctor, models, another Skill, or another --host as a recovery probe. Preserve the original request and any existing task ID; never resubmit automatically. Explain only that this invocation sent no API request. An explicit recheck request or verified new diagnostic evidence permits one relevant check on the same host; changing host requires explicit user selection.

scenarios.when: User asks what Jev is or how to define a rubric.
scenarios.then: Read installed guidance only; do not run models, init or evaluate.

scenarios.when: Multiple independent questions share the same state.
scenarios.then: Use one synchronous request; never make one answer depend on another in that same request.

scenarios.when: User asks to evaluate text without selecting Jev or authorizing an external evaluation request.
scenarios.then: Do ordinary local analysis or clarify the missing evaluation goal. Do not trigger paid evaluate or a catalog/connection probe solely from the word evaluate.

scenarios.when: The input exceeds the local request size, question count or depth limits.
scenarios.then: Explain the limit and any necessary split and expected request count before execution. Clarify unclear scope; never silently expand paid requests, truncate state or change question meaning.

scenarios.when: User asks Jev to judge a photo, audio or video.
scenarios.then: Explain text-only integration; do not silently describe, OCR, upload or transcode media and claim direct evaluation.

scenarios.when: The request times out, returns no receipt or fails response validation.
scenarios.then: Retain unknown outcome; no automatic POST, polling, host switch or no-charge claim. Explain possible repeat billing before an explicitly requested repeat based on mistaken no-charge assumptions.

scenarios.when: A result has high confidence or the user asks to execute a refund based on it.
scenarios.then: Report confidence as uncertainty information, never accuracy proof or authorization. This Skill performs no external side effects.

scenarios.when: Only explicit weights or display order change on existing scores.
scenarios.then: Compute locally using the stated formula; no paid reevaluation and no invented missing scores.

scenarios.when: User specifies a finite set of records.
scenarios.then: Keep that scope, state expected request count, process sequentially once per item and stop on failure/cancellation. Never repeat unknown items or infer unlimited retries.

scenarios.when: User supplies choice options including other or ordered score levels.
scenarios.then: Preserve option names and meanings, including other. Do not invent a threshold or reorder score levels.
